references.text: David speaks of joy and leaping in the presence of God, which can be seen as a parallel to the child's leaping in Elizabeth's womb.
Jeremiah is filled with God's word already in his mother's womb, which can be compared to John being filled with the Holy Spirit while still in Elizabeth's womb.
The angel's prophecy that John will be filled with the Holy Spirit from birth.
Elizabeth confirms that the child leaped in her womb when Mary greeted her, which directly refers to the event in verse 41.
